ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OB$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle COE$. If $\angle AOB=30^\circ$ and $\angle COE=60^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since OB is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and OD is the bisector of $\angle COE$, \\
$\therefore \angle COD= \frac{1}{2} \angle COE$ and $\angle BOC=\angle AOB$, \\
Also, since $\angle AOB=30^\circ$ and $\angle COE=60^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle BOC=30^\circ$ and $\angle COD=30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle BOC+\angle COD=30^\circ+30^\circ=\boxed{60^\circ}$.
